verdict.rationale: Daily's docs claim built-in real-time transcription powered by Deepgram, so live session audio is sent to a transcription service while the call runs. They also say voice AI agents built with Pipecat, its realtime orchestration framework, can be deployed on Daily's infrastructure. Both are one-line marketing claims, and nothing shows audio being streamed to an arbitrary, user-chosen transcription or realtime-model endpoint; RTMP streaming is a separate broadcast feature and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented raw-audio streaming to custom or third-party model endpoints, in-depth docs on the real-time transcription pipeline (latency, configuration), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Real-time and post-call transcription powered by Deepgram.
Deploy voice AI agents built with Pipecat on Daily's global infrastructure.
Pipecat is a vendor-neutral open source orchestration framework for realtime voice and multimodal AI agents.
